text:
emily: Quick heads-up — we need to lock APAC embargo windows and localized landing swaps for the joint cloud listing. Who can confirm press publish + staging cutover times?

raj: I can do the timezone math. rough ask: press embargo 09:00 PT -> that's 01:00 UTC next day, APAC storefront should go live at 10:00 SGT right? need explicit approvals from legal/partners. :clock1:

sophie: Press kit is in GDrive: https://drive.google.com/xxxx (v2). Staging landing for locales: https://staging.redwood.com/marketplace/partner-x-locales — translations in /i18n/ are >90% done. Legal needs to OK partner logo usage before we swap live.

dylan: Staging readiness: feature flag = marketplace-announce-apac. Cutover script is in infra repo. Minimal smoke test (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood.com/announce/switch" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"marketplace-announce-apac","state":"on"}'
```
I'll run the script on the dry-run slot (10:30 SGT).

olivia: Partner assets status: SI logos signed off by partner legal (signed_2025-05-02) but one HW partner still needs co-branding approval (waiting on asset #HW-33). I'll ping them now. Also confirm we can use their screenshot pack on the landing — approved for web only, not for paid ads.

emily: For publishing: blog + press release cadence — blog goes live 10:15 SGT, press release embargo lifts 10:30 SGT, microsite swap at 10:45 SGT. Does that sequencing work?

raj: Sequence OK, but recommend: press release embargo lifts 15 mins before primary APAC push so APAC reporters have time to prepare — propose: embargo lift 10:15 SGT, blog 10:30 SGT, microsite 10:45 SGT.

sophie: Updated timeline noted. Also: add UTM params for partner traffic (utm_source=partner-catalog&utm_campaign=apac_launch). We'll hand over final UTM list to growth.

dylan: One quick note on caching: edge TTLs for /partner pages are 5m on staging; we'll set to 0 on cutover to avoid stale content. I'll add a short rollback window via the flag.

olivia: I've got partner comms covered; I'll escalate HW #HW-33. If they don't sign by EOD APAC, we remove that partner tile and keep a placeholder so legal isn't blocked.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 6312348000 (ETA +30m) — releases blocked during that window.

emily: Good catch, deploy-bot. Let's keep cutover before that window. Final owners: emily (overall), sophie (press assets & blog), raj (embargo/time coordination + media list), dylan (cutover script & smoke), olivia (partner signoffs).

raj: I'll circulate the embargo times in a one-line table for press contacts and their preferred delivery channel.

sophie: Translation owners: @l10n-anna and @l10n-kevin — flagged for final proofread at 09:30 PT.

dylan: I'll push a short runbook to the ops channel with rollback steps and monitoring queries (latency, 5xx rate, token cost delta).

olivia: Confirming I can drop the partner tile as fallback if HW asset isn't signed. I'll pack creative with the approved logos and send to sophie by 09:00 PT.

emily: Perfect — final checklist: 1) legal partner logo approvals (olivia) 2) press embargo times shared (raj) 3) blog + press assets ready (sophie) 4) staging cutover + smoke (dylan) 5) L10n QA (l10n leads) 6) UTM list to growth (sophie). Reply here when your item is done. :white_check_mark:

raj: I'll post the embargo table in 10m.

sophie: Press kit link updated with new hero images and UTMs.

dylan: Ran dry-run smoke against staging — all green. Will run final at 10:20 SGT.

olivia: Partner HW-33 approved at 08:47 PT, sending asset pack now.

emily: Thanks all — this thread is our source of truth for the handoff. Ping in #launch-room for any last-minute issues. :rocket:
